item.title: Laser material test + kerf swatch
item.description: Cut a material test grid (power × speed) and a kerf comb in one sheet material.
item.content:
Cut a material test grid (power × speed) and a kerf comb in one sheet material. Measure the kerf. Cut a living-hinge sample. Label everything on the piece itself.

What to hand in

  • The cut swatch, labeled
  • Settings + kerf measurements in your documentation

What you'll practise

  • Prepare a cut-ready file
  • Measure kerf and record settings

Time: 1 week
